topic: 预处理与采集数据质量
title: 真实Zabbix不变状态停写：心跳修复nodata并验证停止发送仍告警
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 原098证据升级，仍只计原ID一次；真实定时器与事件验证完成前不计原故障恢复。
rubric: 证据显示sender处理成功、链路正常，item使用Discard unchanged且未配置heartbeat，history只保存首次状态1。
根因是相同值被预处理丢弃，nodata观察不到新的持久化值。
改为带heartbeat的丢弃策略，heartbeat须明显短于无数据判定窗口，或用独立持续更新的心跳项；验证持续不变时不误报、停止发送时仍触发。

conversion.original_title: 采集器每分钟发送状态1，Zabbix却触发5分钟无数据告警，原因是什么？

body:
## 操作任务
实现plan_heartbeat(item,heartbeat_seconds,sample_period,nodata_window)，接口及拒绝边界不变：只返回itemid与完整preprocessing链，恰有一个type19/20时只将它改20并设置心跳秒数，保留其他字段/步骤/输入。三个正整数不能为bool，必须心跳+采样周期<nodata窗口；继承/发现对象、非法ID及无或多个throttling拒绝。判分先核验120/60/300预算与多步骤链，再用真实服务端重现持续发送不变值却只落第一条历史、nodata真正告警；应用2/1/30缩放方案使不变值重新周期入库、告警恢复，停止发送后由真实定时器再次告警。不能关闭或改写触发器、伪造历史、只返回throttling一步或改动源对象。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py

## 能力边界
真实Zabbix7.0.32/私有PostgreSQL15.19、trapper不变样本与实际nodata定时器，验证PROBLEM→RECOVERY→PROBLEM；由判分器仅在私有库应用批准的预处理更新，未运行PHP/JSON-RPC API或生产操作。运行夹具缩放为心跳2秒、采样约1秒、nodata30秒；修复后样本携带受控10秒采集/传输延迟，2+1+10<30。另保留120/60/300静态预算和完整链保留检查；不伪造时钟、历史或触发器状态，不证明生产时间SLO。

exercise.environment: 非root隔离Linux；既有本地Zabbix/PG原生工具；2GiB、2CPU；不构建镜像

test_files.checks/check.py:
import sys,os,pathlib,copy,time,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from zabbix_server_fixture import PrivateServer
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
def student(fn,*args):
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:'+fn.__name__,flush=True)
 return fn(*args)
def rejects(fn,*args):
 try:fn(*args)
 except ValueError:return
 raise AssertionError('unsafe input accepted')
item={'itemid':'702','key_':'sender.state','value_type':'3','preprocessing':[{'type':'1','params':'1','error_handler':'0'},{'type':'19','params':'','error_handler':'0','error_handler_params':''},{'type':'13','params':'0\n1','error_handler':'1'}]}
before=copy.deepcopy(item)
patch=student(task.plan_heartbeat,item,120,60,300)
expected=copy.deepcopy(item['preprocessing']);expected[1]['type']=20;expected[1]['params']='120'
assert patch=={'itemid':'702','preprocessing':expected},patch
assert item==before,'mutated source item'
assert student(task.plan_heartbeat,{**item,'preprocessing':expected},120,60,300)==patch
for values in [(240,60,300),(300,60,300),(0,60,300),(120,0,300),(True,60,300)]:rejects(task.plan_heartbeat,item,*values)
for steps in [[],[{'type':'19','params':''},{'type':'20','params':'60'}]]:rejects(task.plan_heartbeat,{**item,'preprocessing':steps},120,60,300)
rejects(task.plan_heartbeat,{**item,'templateid':'88'},120,60,300)

with PrivateServer() as server:
 db=server.db
 db.execute("INSERT INTO hosts(hostid,host,name,status) VALUES(1000000,'training-node','Private training node',0); INSERT INTO items(itemid,hostid,type,name,key_,value_type,history,trends) VALUES(1000001,1000000,2,'Unchanged state','sender.state',3,'1d','0'); INSERT INTO item_rtdata(itemid) VALUES(1000001); INSERT INTO item_preproc(item_preprocid,itemid,step,type,params) VALUES(1000010,1000001,1,19,'')")
 server.start()
 # Normal post-start configuration creates timers incrementally, avoiding the
 # server's documented implementation startup scheduling backoff. No clock,
 # nodata period, trigger function or process security setting is modified.
 db.execute("INSERT INTO triggers(triggerid,expression,description) VALUES(1000002,'{1000005}=1','Private nodata boundary'); INSERT INTO functions(functionid,itemid,triggerid,name,parameter) VALUES(1000005,1000001,1000002,'nodata','$,30s')")
 offset=server.log.stat().st_size;subprocess.run(['zabbix_server','-c',str(server.config),'-R','config_cache_reload'],check=True,capture_output=True,timeout=3)
 server.wait(lambda:'finished forced reloading of the configuration cache' in server.log.read_text()[offset:],'post-start trigger configuration loaded')
 started=time.monotonic();stamp,ack=server.send(1,key='sender.state');print('FIRST_CURRENT_SAMPLE',ack,flush=True)
 def state():return db.execute('select value,state,error from triggers where triggerid=1000002')
 def history():return db.execute('select clock,ns,value from history_uint where itemid=1000001 order by clock,ns')
 while time.monotonic()-started<65:
  server.send(1,key='sender.state');print('OLD',round(time.monotonic()-started,2),state(),history(),flush=True)
  if state() and state()[0][:2]==['1','0']:break
  time.sleep(1)
 assert state()[0][:2]==['1','0'],'real nodata did not become problem before deadline';assert len(history())==1
 approved={'itemid':'1000001','key_':'sender.state','value_type':'3','preprocessing':[{'type':'19','params':'','error_handler':'0','error_handler_params':''}]}
 before=copy.deepcopy(approved)
 patch=student(task.plan_heartbeat,approved,2,1,30)
 assert approved==before and patch=={'itemid':'1000001','preprocessing':[{'type':20,'params':'2','error_handler':'0','error_handler_params':''}]}
 metadata=db.execute('select itemid,hostid,type,key_,value_type,history,trends,status from items where itemid=1000001')
 triggers=db.execute('select triggerid,expression,status from triggers where triggerid=1000002')
 functions=db.execute('select functionid,itemid,triggerid,name,parameter from functions where functionid=1000005')
 old_history=copy.deepcopy(history())
 step=patch['preprocessing'][0]
 db.execute("update item_preproc set type="+str(step['type'])+",params='"+step['params']+"' where item_preprocid=1000010")
 offset=server.log.stat().st_size;subprocess.run(['zabbix_server','-c',str(server.config),'-R','config_cache_reload'],check=True,capture_output=True,timeout=3)
 server.wait(lambda:'finished forced reloading of the configuration cache' in server.log.read_text()[offset:],'current preprocessing reload complete')
 print('CORRECTED_PHASE_CONTROLLED_SOURCE_SAMPLE_DELAY_SECONDS',10,flush=True)
 until=time.monotonic()+6
 while time.monotonic()<until:server.send(1,key='sender.state',stamp=time.time_ns()-10_000_000_000);time.sleep(.8)
 assert len(history())>=3,'heartbeat must really persist unchanged samples'
 print('HEARTBEAT_SAMPLES_ACTUALLY_STORED',round(time.monotonic()-started,2),history(),flush=True)
 while time.monotonic()-started<100:
  print('WAIT_REAL_TIMER',round(time.monotonic()-started,2),state(),flush=True)
  if state()[0][:2]==['0','0']:break
  time.sleep(.4)
 assert state()[0][:2]==['0','0'],'actual timer did not recover after fresh heartbeat'
 print('NATIVE_NODATA_ACTUAL_RECOVERY',round(time.monotonic()-started,2),flush=True)
 while time.monotonic()-started<100:
  if state()[0][:2]==['1','0']:break
  time.sleep(.4)
 assert state()[0][:2]==['1','0'],'actual stopped sender did not become nodata again'
 print('NATIVE_NODATA_ACTUAL_SENDER_STOP_NEW_PROBLEM',round(time.monotonic()-started,2),db.execute('select eventid,value from events where source=0 and object=0 and objectid=1000002 order by eventid'),flush=True)

 assert metadata==db.execute('select itemid,hostid,type,key_,value_type,history,trends,status from items where itemid=1000001')
 assert triggers==db.execute('select triggerid,expression,status from triggers where triggerid=1000002')
 assert functions==db.execute('select functionid,itemid,triggerid,name,parameter from functions where functionid=1000005')
 assert all(row in history() for row in old_history)
 assert db.execute('select value from events where source=0 and object=0 and objectid=1000002 order by eventid')==[['1'],['0'],['1']]
print('NATIVE_ZABBIX_REAL_TIMER_NODATA_PROBLEM_HEARTBEAT_RECOVERY_STOPPED_SENDER_NEW_PROBLEM',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
